title: Artificial night-sky brightness index (2016 = 100)

source.name: Global increase in artificial night sky brightness
source.publisher: Kyba et al., Science (2017) citizen-science analysis, commonly cited ~2%/year global growth rate

notes: Index built from the widely cited ~2% per year global growth rate in artificial sky brightness, compounded from a 2016 baseline of 100. Illustrative index, not a directly measured series.
